function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Authenticate the person on the call before any account or debt information is disclosed. Must be called before get_account_details. If verification fails twice, do not retry a third time.

full_name.description: Full name as stated by the caller.

dob_or_last4_id.description: Date of birth (DD-MM-YYYY) or last 4 digits of the ID/loan account number provided by the caller for verification.

phone_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the registered mobile number, optional secondary factor.

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Fetch the caller's overdue loan details. Only callable after verify_customer has returned verified=true in this call session.

customer_id.description: Internal customer/loan ID returned by verify_customer.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Record a payment commitment (PTP) made by the customer during the call.

ptp_amount.description: Amount in INR the customer committed to pay.

payment_mode.description: How the customer intends to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Trigger an SMS/WhatsApp with a secure payment link to the customer's registered number. Never call before verify_customer has succeeded.

amount.description: Amount in INR to pre-fill in the payment link.

channel.description: Delivery channel for the payment link.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Transfer the live call to a human collections agent, passing full context. Use for hardship needing restructuring, unresolved disputes, sustained hostility, or when the bot cannot progress the conversation.

reason.description: Why the call is being escalated.

call_summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of the conversation so far for the human agent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Close out the call with a final outcome code. Must be called exactly once before the call ends, on every path (including wrong-person, auth-failed, voicemail).
